title: The Mystery of Heat and Temperature
intro: This quiz explores the difference between heat and temperature and how thermometers measure temperature.

choices: How much space an object takes up
How hot or cold something is
How heavy an object is
How quickly an object moves across a room
questions.explanation: Temperature measures how hot or cold something is.

questions.prompt: Which instrument is used to measure temperature?
choices: A ruler
A balance
A thermometer
A measuring cup
questions.explanation: A thermometer is used to measure temperature.

choices: The transfer of thermal energy from a warmer object to a cooler object
The amount of matter inside an object
The space occupied by an object
The color produced by a hot object
questions.explanation: Heat is the transfer of thermal energy from a warmer object to a cooler object.

questions.prompt: What happens when a warm object touches a cooler object?
choices: Heat moves from the cooler object to the warmer object
Heat moves from the warmer object to the cooler object
Both objects immediately freeze
Their temperatures can never change
questions.explanation: When a warm object touches a cooler object, heat moves from the warmer object to the cooler object.

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly explains the difference between heat and temperature?
choices: Heat and temperature always mean exactly the same thing
Temperature measures hotness or coldness, while heat is energy moving between objects
Heat is measured with a ruler, while temperature is measured with a scale
Temperature moves between objects, but heat stays still
questions.explanation: Temperature measures hotness or coldness, while heat is energy moving between objects.
